name: Crystal Description
description: Generate crystal structure descriptions from CIF files online or with the CrystalDesk Windows offline client. The online service uses a hosted Python backend; CrystalDesk processes files locally and requires activation.
features: CIF structure descriptions generated by the hosted Robocrys Python backend
Embedded Streamlit workspace with a direct service link
SnO₂ example, copy and download within the original service
Community-hosted service; confidential structures should not be uploaded
CrystalDesk Windows offline client: local CIF processing, a bundled SnO₂ example and TXT/JSON export
Portable Windows x64 ZIP with bundled runtimes; extract the entire folder and run CrystalDesk.exe
Windows use requires developer-issued machine-bound activation via a .cdlicense file

history.notes: CrystalDesk Windows offline download is now available alongside the online Crystal Description workspace. Windows use requires manual machine-bound activation.

zh.description: 从 CIF 文件生成晶体结构描述，可使用在线服务或 CrystalDesk Windows 离线客户端。在线服务由托管 Python 后端处理文件；CrystalDesk 在本机处理文件，使用前需要激活。
features: 由托管的 Robocrys Python 后端生成 CIF 结构描述
嵌入 Streamlit 工作区，并提供直接打开服务的入口
保留原服务的 SnO₂ 示例、复制和下载功能
使用社区托管服务，请勿上传保密结构
CrystalDesk Windows 离线客户端：在本机处理 CIF，内置 SnO₂ 示例并支持 TXT/JSON 导出
Windows x64 便携压缩包包含所需运行环境；完整解压后运行 CrystalDesk.exe
Windows 版通过开发者签发的 .cdlicense 文件完成本机激活

historyNotes.1.0.0: CrystalDesk Windows 离线版现已开放下载，同时保留在线晶体描述工作区。Windows 版需要开发者手动签发本机授权。
